title: mail: TLS via rustls (HTTPS for JMAP)
description:
Add rustls-backed HTTPS to the axum server in crates/mail/src/tls.rs: load cert_path and key_path from config (PEM), construct rustls ServerConfig, wrap TcpListener in TlsAcceptor. If cert/key absent, log warning and serve plain HTTP only (development mode). Follow same pattern as usenet-ipfs-reader tls.rs.

Why: JMAP over plain HTTP exposes passwords and message content; production deployments must use HTTPS.

Acceptance: with cert/key configured, curl --cacert accepts the connection; without them, server starts in plaintext mode with a warning.
